# Redline

> Redline is the verified-payee layer for AI agents. Vendors prove once that their payout accounts on NEAR, EVM chains or Solana belong to their website domain. Agents read that record before money moves.

## When to use which

- You know the vendor's website: call resolve. It returns the verified account, so you never handle a raw address.
- You have a raw address, from an invoice, an email or an x402 offer: call check before paying.

Accounts are CAIP-10 strings: near:testnet:northwind.testnet, eip155:84532:0xabc..., solana:devnet:7xKX... A bare NEAR account id is also accepted.

## Verdicts

- PAY: pay. The account is verified for this vendor and nothing looks wrong.
- HOLD: do not pay. Send it to a human. Reasons: NOT_IN_REGISTRY, CHAIN_NOT_VERIFIED, COOLING_OFF, NEW_ACCOUNT, RECENT_FULL_ACCESS_KEY, RECENT_CODE_CHANGE, PAYEE_CHANGED, SIGNALS_UNAVAILABLE.
- BLOCK: never pay. Reasons: ACCOUNT_MISSING, LOOKALIKE_ACCOUNT, ACCOUNT_NOT_VENDORS.

If a call fails or returns an error, there is no verdict. Do not pay.

## MCP

Streamable HTTP: http://127.0.0.1:8790/mcp
Stdio: node services/mcp/dist/stdio.js
Tools: resolve_payee, check_payee, get_vendor, how_to_verify

## HTTP

Base URL: http://127.0.0.1:8787

```sh
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1/resolve -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"domain":"northwind.com","chain":"near:testnet"}'

curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1/check -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"payee":"near:testnet:northw1nd.testnet","vendor":{"domain":"northwind.com"}}'
```

Other routes: GET /v1/vendors, GET /v1/vendors/{domain}, POST /v1/payments/record, POST /v1/vendors/verify, GET /.well-known/redline-attestor.json.

Free tier: 200 calls per day per IP. Over that, HTTP 402 with x402 payment requirements of 0.01 USDC per call. Paying it is not available yet.

## SDK

```ts
import { createRedline, assertPayable } from "@redline/sdk";
const redline = createRedline({ mode: "hosted", baseUrl: "http://127.0.0.1:8787" });
const result = await redline.resolve({ domain: "northwind.com", chain: "near:testnet" });
assertPayable(result);
pay(result.account);
```

Direct mode runs the checks locally, so Redline never sees who you pay: createRedline({ mode: "direct", nearRpcUrl, registryAccount }).

x402: wrapFetchWithPayment(withRedline(fetch, { redline }), x402Client), from @redline/x402-guard.

## Receipts

Hosted answers carry an ed25519 receipt signed by the Redline API. The public key is at /.well-known/redline-attestor.json. Check one with verifyReceipt(result, publicKey, { request }). Direct mode has no receipts.

## For vendors

Serve https://<domain>/.well-known/redline-payee.json, signed by each payout account, then POST {"domain":"<domain>"} to /v1/vendors/verify. The how_to_verify tool has the steps.
